message.content:
Fix a critical navigation bug across the entire Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app.

## The Bug
In Shopify embedded apps, `<Button url="/app/...">` creates an `<a href>` that navigates OUTSIDE the iframe, causing the Shopify admin to show a "store URL" prompt. The fix is to use `onClick={() => navigate("/app/...")}` with React Router's `useNavigate()` hook instead.

## What to Fix
Every `<Button url="/app/...">` in every route file needs to be changed to `<Button onClick={() => navigate("/app/...")}>`.

**IMPORTANT**: Only fix `url="/app/..."` routes (internal app navigation). Do NOT touch:
- External URLs like `url="mailto:..."` or `url="https://..."` — those are fine as `url=`
- The `Page backAction` — those already use `onAction`

## Files to fix (search each one):

1. `app/routes/app.settings.tsx` — has `url="/app/pricing"` and `url="/app/widget"`. Make sure `useNavigate` is imported and `navigate` is available in the component.

2. `app/routes/app.recommender.tsx` — has `url="/app/pricing"` and `url="/app/size-charts"`. Make sure `useNavigate` is imported.

3. `app/routes/app.analytics.tsx` — has `url="/app/pricing"`, `url="/app/size-charts"`, `url="/app/widget"`. Make sure `useNavigate` is imported.

4. `app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx` — has `url="/app/pricing"`. Already has `useNavigate` imported and `navigate` variable.

5. `app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` — has `url="/app/recommender"`. Already has `useNavigate` imported.

6. `app/routes/app._index.tsx` — has many `url="/app/size-charts"`, `url="/app/pricing"`, `url="/app/widget"`, `url="/app/recommender"`, `url="/app/analytics"`, `url="/app/settings"`. Make sure `useNavigate` is imported and `navigate` is available.

## Steps for each file:
1. Read the file
2. Check if `useNavigate` is imported from `react-router` — if not, add it
3. Check if `const navigate = useNavigate()` exists in the component — if not, add it
4. Replace every `<Button ... url="/app/...">` with `<Button ... onClick={() => navigate("/app/...")}>` 
5. Keep ALL other props (variant, tone, loading, etc.) unchanged

## After fixing all files:
Run `npm run typecheck` to verify zero errors. Fix any issues found.

Do NOT change any other functionality.

## Bug Fix Report

**Root cause**: Polaris `<Button url="/app/...">` renders an `<a href>` tag. In a Shopify embedded app (iframe context), clicking an `<a href>` navigates the top-level window rather than the iframe, causing Shopify admin to prompt for a store URL instead of navigating within the app.

**Category**: [C] Polaris Web Component / App Bridge — embedded app iframe navigation

**Files changed**:
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app._index.tsx` — added `useNavigate` import + `navigate` variable; replaced 14 `url=` instances (including 1 `Page primaryAction url:` → `onAction:`)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.settings.tsx` — replaced 3 `url=` instances (lines 363, 396, 567)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.recommender.tsx` — replaced 4 `url=` instances (lines 554, 708, 832, 956)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.analytics.tsx` — replaced 6 `url=` instances (lines 313x2, 388, 404x2, 565 dynamic, 618)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx` — replaced 2 `url=` instances (lines 523, 806)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` — replaced 1 `url=` instance (line 1427)

**Fix applied**: Every `<Button url="/app/...">` changed to `<Button onClick={() => navigate("/app/...")}>`. The `Page primaryAction` object's `url:` property in `app._index.tsx` was changed to `onAction:` (correct API for that prop).
